auth.title: Welcome home
auth.description: Sign in with the owner's Google account to open your budget.
auth.unavailable: Sign-in is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
auth.error: Sign-in was denied or could not be completed. Please try again with the authorized account.

shell.tagline: A clear view of your budget

preferences.saved: Your preferences are saved in this browser.
preferences.error: Could not save the language. Please try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This page is unavailable. You can return to your overview.

screens.eyebrow: A little more clarity, every day
screens.notice: This is an interface preview. Financial features are in development; no bank data is connected.

overview.title: Make room for what matters
overview.description: Your confirmed balance and spending guidance will appear here when budget updates are available.

obligations.title: Keep commitments in view
obligations.description: Future updates will show unpaid obligations, their full reserves and payment history here.

savings.title: Space for your plans
savings.description: Future updates will let you set money aside for your goals and follow changes over time.

months.title: Every month has its story
months.description: Budget periods and versioned month reports will appear here in a future update.

settings.title: Make yourself at home
settings.description: Choose your language and appearance. These preferences work now and stay with this browser.

dashboard.bankBasis: This is the last observation, not a guarantee of today’s bank balance.
dashboard.bankNoncurrent: Last check of the whole card. This is not the closing balance of the selected month.
dashboard.safeTitle: Daily limit based on the check on {date}
dashboard.ordinaryBasis: The budget guideline is separate. Use the safe limit for discretionary spending.
dashboard.futureBasis: Full calendar month preview using already confirmed funds. These are not funds available today or expected income.
dashboard.pastBasis: This is the active allocation for the selected month. A historical report is not yet available here. Daily guidance is unavailable for past periods.

notice.EARLIER_OBSERVATION: This calculation uses an earlier card check. The current bank balance may differ.
notice.REMINDER_DUE: The last check was at least 7 calendar days ago. Check your card balance. Recording a new check will be available in a later update.
notice.MONTH_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Review the data after the month changes. Money and reserves are not transferred automatically.
notice.CURRENT_UNFUNDED: No confirmed money is allocated to the current month.

dashboard.shortage: Shortfall of {amount} based on the card check

meaning.OBLIGATIONS_UNDERFUNDED: To cover all fully reserved unpaid obligations across all months.
meaning.EARMARKS_UNDERFUNDED: To cover all obligations and retained savings together across all months.
meaning.PROTECTION_UNDERFUNDED: To preserve other months’ money and all full reserves and savings.

dashboard.nonAdditive: Do not add these amounts: they describe overlapping comparisons.
dashboard.budgetGap: The budget guideline exceeds the safely available amount because reserves and other months’ money are protected.

unavailable.INCOMPLETE_STATE: Insufficient confirmed data for a calculation
unavailable.OVERDRAFT_POLICY_REQUIRED: Budget calculation is unavailable for a negative card balance

dashboard.noEstimate: No numeric forecast is available. Missing data does not mean a zero balance.
dashboard.known: Known full reserves and savings; cash coverage is unknown:
dashboard.readOnly: This screen only displays confirmed data. Reading does not change the budget.

state.NO_ACCOUNT: The account is not set up yet
state.ACCOUNT_SELECTION_REQUIRED: An account could not be selected unambiguously
state.STORAGE_ERROR: Could not load the budget. Please try again.
state.PROJECTION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: There is too much data to calculate the projection
